headlines.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as Acclaimed & B.Gunn vs. Top Flight & Andretti went to war, appearing on Collision, rated 6.15. It was the first title opportunity of Top Flight & Andretti's career. Acclaimed & B.Gunn was chasing gold for the 10th time. The Acclaimed and Billy Gunn fought off a spirited challenge from Top Flight and Action Andretti, closing it out with the Mic Drop/Total Elimination combo to retain the AEW World Trios Championship.

Rewind to 2020, when The Young Bucks vs. The Acclaimed fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.71. It was the first title opportunity of The Acclaimed's career. It was the 20th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. An early title opportunity for a very new team, just one week into their AEW Dynamite run ? The Acclaimed pushed the champions to their limit before the Bucks retained with the BTE Trigger, a real signal of the bright future ahead for Bowens and Caster.
Flash back to 2022, when Preston Vance stepped through the curtain for the first time in a Casino Battle Royale match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.24.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Eddie Kingston vs. Andrade El Idolo met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.48 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? part of a stacked Holiday Bash '23 - Night 3 card, rated 8.48 overall.
